description: A ground-level photograph depicts an expansive coastal salt marsh landscape under a clear blue sky with scattered clouds. The scene is dominated by low-lying, dense vegetation exhibiting a mix of green and brownish hues, characteristic of salt-tolerant plants, sedges, and rushes, extending towards the horizon. In the immediate foreground, to the right of some light-coloured rocks on the lower left, there is a small, shallow body of brownish water or very wet, muddy ground. The overall terrain appears flat and open, consistent with a wetland environment. Faint, unreadable text is partially visible in the bottom left corner.
